caption:
sunday didn't know it was a workout

#healthylifestyle #fitnessapp #soma

slides.text:
It noticed I trained

and asked if it counted

Sunday hike

Not on any plan

By morning it had seen it

And asked, not assumed

One tap to count it

The week's load
knew about Sunday

Movement counts
even when it isn't training

slides.heading: It keeps honest books
slides.body: SOMA picks up workouts your watch detected and asks before counting them toward your week
